data.body: TDD checkpoint: added focused cross-surface regressions first and confirmed 7 initial failures. Implemented one shared pure parser, wired standalone clarity, then wired deterministic P1. Current verification: tests/unit/test_clarity_floor.py 24 passed; existing direct consumers plus broader plan-review unit coverage 142 passed. Review advisories were resolved as immediate trigger-word proximity and whole-word suppression matching. TokenSave reduced initial code-navigation context by approximately 42,505 tokens.
